name: CW — 32. Yardi Sheet → Firestore Lead Sync (fixed v2)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ structuredQuery: { from: [{ collectionId: "leads" }], where: { fieldFilter: { field: { fieldPath: $json.dedupe_field }, op: "EQUAL", value: { stringValue: $json.dedupe_value } } }, limit: 1 } }) }}

nodes.name: Query Firestore for existing email/phone
nodes.notes: Queries by email when Parse Rows found one; otherwise falls back to phone_digits (set on every lead this workflow creates -- see Create Lead node). Pre-existing leads entered by hand may not have a phone_digits field or may store phone with punctuation, so this can miss a true duplicate for those older docs -- same class of tradeoff already accepted for email-only exact-match dedup.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ collection: "leads", action: "create", fields: { company: $json.tenant, contact: $json.tenant, email: $json.email, phone: $json.phone, phone_digits: $json.phone, first_name: $json.first_name, location: ($json.property + (($json.address) ? (" (" + $json.address + ")") : "")), stage: "lead", yardi_milestone: $json.sub_stage, notes: ("From Yardi: " + $json.last_activity_comment), status: "new", createdAt: (new Date()).toISOString(), archived: false, seq_status: "active", source: "yardi", qualifying_email_status: ((!$json.email) || (!$json.email.includes('@')) ? "no_email" : "pending") } }) }}

nodes.name: Create Lead (via workflow 20)
nodes.notes: 2026-08-18: added source:'yardi' and qualifying_email_status:'pending' -- these are what workflow 33 (Send Initial Qualifying Email) keys off of. Deliberately NOT using yardi_milestone for this -- confirmed live 2026-08-18 that it's not a reliable marker (blank on a genuine fresh Yardi lead, non-blank on an old lead months into a deal, since something else appears to sync yardi_milestone onto matched leads independent of how the doc was created). source/qualifying_email_status are set ONLY here, at creation, by this node -- nothing else touches them, so a plain EQUAL filter on both is safe. Side effect: every lead already in Firestore before this change has neither field, so workflow 33's query can never match historical backlog -- no separate freshness/cutoff logic needed.
